title: Integrated Longitudinal and Lateral Control for High-Speed Platooning of Articulated Vehicles
description:
arXiv:2610.30437v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper presents an integrated control framework for high-speed platooning of articulated vehicles, combining advanced longitudinal and lateral control strategies to address the challenges of safe and efficient autonomous driving. A novel proof of string stability for the proposed longitudinal control algorithm, based on a PID framework, ensures robust inter-vehicle distance regulation even under dynamic operating conditions.
